about: Build log of the place leon (Casco Histórico, León) by cwplans/tools/build-place-tiles.mjs: what was fetched (URL, date, SHA-256) and each dataflow activity with its input and output hashes. Raw files stay in cwplans/data/raw/places/leon/ (not committed).

osm.stored_as: the elements of all answers merged by type and id, gzip JSON (sha256 above); the answers as fetched: as_fetched

heights-es-catastro.note: the original zip and the parts stay in the raw folder (licence: transformed data only)

heights-world-ghsl.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Commission Decision 2011/833/EU; copyright.txt: "(c) European Union, 1995-2026")
heights-world-ghsl.note: the tile zip stays in the raw folder; the committed crop is the input of place-heights

as_fetched.note: HTTP range requests of Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs (overview 1, about 20 m): no single file as fetched; the windows and the stored grid (sha256) fix the input

heights-ms-city.note: footprints with a height over the core and city box; raw (input of place-city-heights)

overture-roads.request: DuckDB read_parquet over HTTPS of the 128 files of the release, filter on bbox and: (subtype = 'road' AND class IN ('motorway','trunk','primary','secondary','tertiary')) OR subtype = 'rail'
overture-roads.licence: ODbL 1.0 (OpenStreetMap-derived records; the record sources list names each source and licence)

as_fetched.note: the query answer as written by cwplans/tools/fetch-overture-theme.py (raw folder); sha256 above

overture-streets.request: DuckDB read_parquet over HTTPS of the 128 files of the release, filter on bbox and: subtype = 'road' AND class IN ('residential','unclassified','living_street','pedestrian','service')
overture-streets.licence: ODbL 1.0 (OpenStreetMap-derived records; the record sources list names each source and licence)

as_fetched.note: the query answer as written by cwplans/tools/fetch-overture-theme.py (raw folder); sha256 above

as_fetched.note: the query answer as written by cwplans/tools/fetch-overture-theme.py (raw folder); sha256 above

as_fetched.note: the query answer as written by cwplans/tools/fetch-overture-theme.py (raw folder); sha256 above

heights-overture-ign-floors.request: the city buildings answer of world-overture-outer (query "buildings"), rows whose num_floors source dataset is Instituto Geográfico Nacional (España)
heights-overture-ign-floors.licence: not stated (the Overture sources entry has an empty licence field); IGN data are generally CC BY 4.0, not confirmed for these records
